description: Implementation of a VP8 raw stream parser, including functions for parsing frame headers, segmentation, loop filter, quantization, and partition sizes, as well as handling external dependencies and internal class methods.

classes.name: Vp8FrameHeader
classes.description: Structure representing the header information of a VP8 frame, including frame type, size, and segmentation details.

classes.name: Vp8SegmentationHeader
classes.description: Structure holding segmentation parameters for VP8 frames.

classes.name: Vp8LoopFilterHeader
classes.description: Structure for loop filter parameters in VP8 frames.

classes.name: Vp8QuantizationHeader
classes.description: Structure for quantization parameters in VP8 frames.

classes.name: Vp8Parser
classes.description: Main class responsible for parsing VP8 stream frames, headers, segmentation, loop filter, quantization, and partitions.

methods.name: ParseFrame
methods.description: Parses a VP8 frame from a byte stream, extracting header, segmentation, partitions, and other frame data.

methods.name: ParseFrameTag
methods.description: Parses the frame tag to determine frame type, size, and keyframe indicators.

methods.name: ParseFrameHeader
methods.description: Parses detailed frame header including segmentation, loop filter, quantization, and probabilities.

methods.name: ParseSegmentationHeader
methods.description: Parses segmentation parameters for the frame.

methods.name: ParseTokenProbs
methods.description: Parses token probabilities for entropy coding.

methods.name: ParsePartitions
methods.description: Parses partition sizes for the frame.

methods.name: ResetProbs
methods.description: Resets probability tables to default values.
